CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Docker Folders** — drag and drop your Docker containers into folders.
Adds a "Folders" tab under the Docker menu where you can group containers into folders with custom icons and colors, then start, stop, restart, and update them from one place.
- Live CPU, memory, network, and I/O stats - Schedules to run container actions on a cron - Port collision warnings before you start a container - Image update checks with release notes and batch pulls - Docker Compose editing and automatic stack grouping - Inline container logs - Real-time updates over WebSocket, so every open tab stays in sync
Most of it is togglable — stats, folder ports, inline logs, health indicators, update checks, and notifications can each be turned on or off, and the plugin can optionally replace Unraid's built-in Docker section entirely.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/rizowski/unraid-docker-folders/issues
